description: Who could be speaking in each reviewed lesson photo, and where. A speaker bubble (user decision 2026-11-12) marks the cast member who is talking, only on photos that show two or more people. Anchors are crown points (top of the head, horizontal centre) on the complete 3:2 runtime image, 0..1 of its width and height, bound to the image's sha256. `owner` is the cast member whose own line the photo was made for; picture choices mark it. Rules: mobile/src/speakerBubble.ts; checks: mobile/tests/speaker-bubble.test.cjs. A1+ Unit 1 lessons 1.1-1.6 are registered; A1 photos follow in a later sweep.
